userSpecifiedSources: Baseball Savant Statcast search (MLB Advanced Media), https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search : every regular-season pitch, one CSV request per day. Season dates, the regular-season schedule and player names/handedness from MLB StatsAPI, https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1 . Built by build.py in https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets (dataset4_statcast_bat_tracking), which publishes nothing unless every gate in the description passes.

statcast_2024.parquet.description: Every regular-season pitch of the 2024 MLB season from Baseball Savant (one row per pitch, bat tracking included), Parquet with zstd compression. Savant's 8 always-empty deprecated columns are dropped; pitch_uid, is_swing, is_whiff and in_zone are added. The bat tracking columns are bat_speed, swing_length, miss_distance, attack_angle, attack_direction, swing_path_tilt, intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches and intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches. Neutral-site games with columns empty for the whole game (measured): 2024-03-20 Seoul (Gocheok Sky Dome), game_pk 745444: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2024-03-21 Seoul (Gocheok Sky Dome), game_pk 746175: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2024-04-27 Mexico City (Estadio Alfredo Harp Helu), game_pk 746560: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2024-04-28 Mexico City (Estadio Alfredo Harp Helu), game_pk 746561: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2024-06-08 London Stadium, game_pk 745814: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle, effective_speed, release_extension, release_spin_rate, spin_axis; 2024-06-09 London Stadium, game_pk 745571: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle, effective_speed, release_extension, release_spin_rate, spin_axis; 2024-06-20 Rickwood Field, game_pk 745164: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2024-08-18 Williamsport (Journey Bank Ballpark), game_pk 746431: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle.

columns.pitch_type: Statcast pitch classification code. FF=Four-seam fastball, SL=Slider, CH=Changeup, CU=Curveball, SI=Sinker, FC=Cutter, FS=Splitter, KC=Knuckle Curve, EP=Eephus, FO=Forkball, KN=Knuckleball, ST=Sweeper. Empty on pitch-clock automatic balls and strikes (description automatic_ball / automatic_strike), where no pitch was tracked.
columns.game_date: Date of the game in YYYY-MM-DD format.
columns.release_speed: Pitch velocity out of the hand, in mph.
columns.release_pos_x: Horizontal release position of the ball in feet, from the catcher's perspective.
columns.release_pos_z: Vertical release position of the ball in feet above the ground.
columns.player_name: Name of the PITCHER, 'Last, First' (Savant's pitch search is by pitcher). Batter names are in players.csv (join on batter = player_id).
columns.batter: MLB Advanced Media player ID for the batter.
columns.pitcher: MLB Advanced Media player ID for the pitcher.
columns.events: Outcome of plate appearance if pitch ended the at-bat (single, double, triple, home_run, strikeout, walk, field_out, etc.). Null for pitches that did not end PA.
columns.zone: Zone of the ball as it crosses the plate, from the catcher's perspective: 1-9 in the strike zone (1 = top left to 9 = bottom right), 11-14 outside it.
columns.des: Natural language description of the play.
columns.game_type: Type of game. Always R (regular season) in this dataset.
columns.home_team: Home team abbreviation (e.g. NYY, LAD, BOS).
columns.type: Pitch outcome type. S=Strike, B=Ball, X=In play.
columns.hit_location: Fielder position number where ball was hit. 1=Pitcher, 2=Catcher, 3=1B, 4=2B, 5=3B, 6=SS, 7=LF, 8=CF, 9=RF.
columns.bb_type: Batted ball type: ground_ball, line_drive, fly_ball, or popup.
columns.balls: Number of balls in the count (0-3).
columns.strikes: Number of strikes in the count (0-2).
columns.pfx_x: Horizontal movement in FEET, from the catcher's perspective (gravity removed).
columns.pfx_z: Vertical movement in FEET, from the catcher's perspective (gravity removed).
columns.plate_x: Horizontal position of the ball in feet when it crosses home plate, from the catcher's perspective (0 = center). Through 2025 measured at the front of the plate; from 2026 at the middle of the plate (aligned with the ABS system).
columns.plate_z: Vertical position of the ball in feet above the ground when it crosses home plate. Through 2025 measured at the front of the plate; from 2026 at the middle of the plate (aligned with the ABS system).
columns.on_3b: MLBAM id of the runner on third base before the pitch (empty if none).
columns.on_2b: MLBAM id of the runner on second base before the pitch (empty if none).
columns.on_1b: MLBAM id of the runner on first base before the pitch (empty if none).
columns.outs_when_up: Number of outs when batter came to plate (0-2).
columns.inning: Inning number (1-9 for regulation, 10+ for extra innings).
columns.hc_x: Hit coordinate x of the batted ball (Savant spray-chart coordinates).
columns.hc_y: Hit coordinate y of the batted ball (Savant spray-chart coordinates).
columns.vx0: Velocity of the pitch in ft/s in the x direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.vy0: Velocity of the pitch in ft/s in the y direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.vz0: Velocity of the pitch in ft/s in the z direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.ax: Acceleration of the pitch in ft/s^2 in the x direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.ay: Acceleration of the pitch in ft/s^2 in the y direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.az: Acceleration of the pitch in ft/s^2 in the z direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.sz_top: Top of the batter's strike zone in feet. Through 2025 set by the operator when the ball is halfway to the plate; from 2026 the top of the batter's ABS-defined strike zone.
columns.sz_bot: Bottom of the batter's strike zone in feet. Through 2025 set by the operator when the ball is halfway to the plate; from 2026 the bottom of the batter's ABS-defined strike zone.
columns.hit_distance_sc: Projected hit distance in feet based on launch speed and angle using physics model.
columns.launch_speed: Exit velocity of batted ball in miles per hour (mph). Higher values correlate with harder hits and better outcomes.
columns.launch_angle: Vertical angle of batted ball in degrees. Optimal for home runs is 25-35°. Line drives: 10-25°, fly balls: 25-50°, ground balls: <10°.
columns.effective_speed: Perceived velocity in mph, derived from release speed and the extension of the pitcher's release. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.release_spin_rate: Spin rate at release in revolutions per minute (rpm). Higher spin typically creates more movement. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.release_extension: Distance in feet from rubber to release point. Longer extension means ball is released closer to home plate. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.game_pk: Unique MLB Advanced Media game identifier.
columns.release_pos_y: Release position of the ball in feet from home plate (y, toward the mound).
columns.estimated_ba_using_speedangle: Expected batting average based on launch speed and angle from historical outcomes. Scale: 0-1.0 (e.g. 0.500 = 50% hit probability).
columns.estimated_woba_using_speedangle: Expected wOBA (xwOBA) of the batted ball from its exit velocity and launch angle (and, for some batted balls, sprint speed).
columns.woba_value: Actual wOBA value for the outcome weighted by run expectancy.
columns.woba_denom: wOBA denominator of the play (1 when the plate appearance counts toward wOBA, else 0).
columns.iso_value: ISO value of the play (extra bases: 1 for a double, 2 for a triple, 3 for a home run, else 0).
columns.launch_speed_angle: Launch speed/angle category: 1 = Weak, 2 = Topped, 3 = Under, 4 = Flare/Burner, 5 = Solid Contact, 6 = Barrel.
columns.at_bat_number: Sequential at-bat number within the game.
columns.pitch_number: Sequential pitch number within the at-bat.
columns.home_score: Home team score at time of pitch.
columns.away_score: Away team score at time of pitch.
columns.bat_score: Batting team score at time of pitch.
columns.fld_score: Fielding team score at time of pitch.
columns.post_away_score: Away team score after the play.
columns.post_home_score: Home team score after the play.
columns.post_bat_score: Batting team score after the play.
columns.post_fld_score: Fielding team score after the play.
columns.if_fielding_alignment: Infield positioning: Standard, Infield shift, or Strategic. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.of_fielding_alignment: Outfield positioning: Standard, 4th outfielder, or Strategic. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.spin_axis: Tilt of spin axis in degrees (0-360). 180° = pure backspin (fastball), 0° = pure topspin (12-6 curveball). Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.delta_home_win_exp: Change in home team win expectancy after the play. Positive = increased win probability, negative = decreased.
columns.delta_run_exp: Change in run expectancy after the play measured in expected runs scored in remainder of inning.
columns.bat_speed: Bat speed in mph, measured at the sweet spot (six inches from the head of the bat). Filled on swings tracked by Statcast bat tracking (about 46% of all pitches). Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.swing_length: Swing length in feet: the total distance traveled by the head of the bat from the start of tracking until contact. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.miss_distance: Filled only on swinging strikes with bat tracking. Not yet in Savant's CSV documentation; Savant publishes it with its 'Swing Timing + Miss Distance' leaderboard. Values run from 0.1 to about 40 (median about 1.6), consistent with how far the bat missed the ball in inches; the unit is not documented. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.estimated_slg_using_speedangle: Expected slugging percentage based on launch speed and angle. Scale: 0-4.0 (1.0=single, 2.0=double, 3.0=triple, 4.0=HR).
columns.delta_pitcher_run_exp: Change in run expectancy from the pitcher's side (the negative of delta_run_exp).
columns.hyper_speed: Adjusted exit velocity in mph (Savant's 'Adjusted EV'): batted balls under 88 mph are set to 88, others keep their exit velocity.
columns.home_score_diff: Home team run differential (home score minus away score).
columns.home_win_exp: Home team win expectancy (0-1) at time of pitch based on score, inning, outs, and runners.
columns.age_pit_legacy: Pitcher's age on June 30 of the season (integer).
columns.age_bat_legacy: Batter's age on June 30 of the season (integer).
columns.age_pit: Pitcher's age on December 31 of the season (integer).
columns.age_bat: Batter's age on December 31 of the season (integer).
columns.n_thruorder_pitcher: Times through the batting order for the pitcher (1, 2, 3, ...).
columns.n_priorpa_thisgame_player_at_bat: Number of prior plate appearances by this batter in this game.
columns.pitcher_days_since_prev_game: Days since the pitcher's previous game (empty for his first game of the season).
columns.batter_days_since_prev_game: Days since the batter's previous game (empty for his first game of the season).
columns.pitcher_days_until_next_game: Days until the pitcher's next game (empty for his last game of the season).
columns.batter_days_until_next_game: Days until the batter's next game (empty for his last game of the season).
columns.api_break_z_with_gravity: Vertical break of the pitch in inches, gravity included.
columns.api_break_x_arm: Horizontal break of the pitch in inches toward the pitcher's arm side.
columns.api_break_x_batter_in: Horizontal break of the pitch in inches toward the batter's side of the plate.
columns.arm_angle: Pitcher's arm angle in degrees: the angle between a line parallel to the ground and a line from the throwing shoulder to the ball at release. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.attack_angle: Attack angle in degrees: the vertical angle, compared to the ground, of the direction the bat's sweet spot is traveling as it meets the ball. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.attack_direction: Attack direction in degrees: the horizontal angle of the direction the bat's sweet spot is traveling as it meets the ball, compared to the line from home plate to straightaway center field. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.swing_path_tilt: Swing path tilt in degrees: the vertical orientation of the plane of the swing, compared to the ground, over the 40 ms before contact. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches: Distance in inches between the bat/ball intercept point and the batter's center of mass, in the x (horizontal) direction. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches: Distance in inches between the bat/ball intercept point and the batter's center of mass, in the y (mound-to-plate) direction. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.pitch_uid: Added here: unique pitch id 'game_pk-at_bat_number-pitch_number' (checked unique across all three seasons).
columns.is_swing: Added here: the batter swung. True for descriptions swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, missed_bunt, foul_tip, bunt_foul_tip, swinging_pitchout, foul, foul_bunt, foul_pitchout and hit_into_play (daily totals equal Savant's swing counts).
columns.is_whiff: Added here: a whiff as Baseball Savant counts it: swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, missed_bunt, foul_tip, bunt_foul_tip and swinging_pitchout. Foul tips count as whiffs, as in Savant's own whiff totals (daily totals checked equal).
columns.in_zone: Added here: zone is 1-9 (True) or 11-14 (False); empty when zone is empty.

Savant's 8 always-empty deprecated columns are dropped; pitch_uid, is_swing, is_whiff and in_zone are added. The bat tracking columns are bat_speed, swing_length, miss_distance, attack_angle, attack_direction, swing_path_tilt, intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches and intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches. Neutral-site games with columns empty for the whole game (measured): 2026-04-25 Mexico City (Estadio Alfredo Harp Helu), game_pk 825093: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2026-04-26 Mexico City (Estadio Alfredo Harp Helu), game_pk 825094: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2026-06-08 Las Vegas Ballpark, game_pk 824998: all bat tracking columns; 2026-06-09 Las Vegas Ballpark, game_pk 824999: all bat tracking columns; 2026-06-10 Las Vegas Ballpark, game_pk 824996: all bat tracking columns; 2026-06-12 Las Vegas Ballpark, game_pk 824997: all bat tracking columns; 2026-06-13 Las Vegas Ballpark, game_pk 824995: all bat tracking columns; 2026-06-14 Las Vegas Ballpark, game_pk 824994: all bat tracking columns; 2026-08-13 Field of Dreams, game_pk 823669: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle; 2026-08-23 Williamsport (Journey Bank Ballpark), game_pk 823745: all bat tracking columns, if/of_fielding_alignment, arm_angle.

columns.pitch_type: Statcast pitch classification code. FF=Four-seam fastball, SL=Slider, CH=Changeup, CU=Curveball, SI=Sinker, FC=Cutter, FS=Splitter, KC=Knuckle Curve, EP=Eephus, FO=Forkball, KN=Knuckleball, ST=Sweeper. Empty on pitch-clock automatic balls and strikes (description automatic_ball / automatic_strike), where no pitch was tracked.
columns.game_date: Date of the game in YYYY-MM-DD format.
columns.release_speed: Pitch velocity out of the hand, in mph.
columns.release_pos_x: Horizontal release position of the ball in feet, from the catcher's perspective.
columns.release_pos_z: Vertical release position of the ball in feet above the ground.
columns.player_name: Name of the PITCHER, 'Last, First' (Savant's pitch search is by pitcher). Batter names are in players.csv (join on batter = player_id).
columns.batter: MLB Advanced Media player ID for the batter.
columns.pitcher: MLB Advanced Media player ID for the pitcher.
columns.events: Outcome of plate appearance if pitch ended the at-bat (single, double, triple, home_run, strikeout, walk, field_out, etc.). Null for pitches that did not end PA.
columns.zone: Zone of the ball as it crosses the plate, from the catcher's perspective: 1-9 in the strike zone (1 = top left to 9 = bottom right), 11-14 outside it.
columns.des: Natural language description of the play.
columns.game_type: Type of game. Always R (regular season) in this dataset.
columns.home_team: Home team abbreviation (e.g. NYY, LAD, BOS).
columns.type: Pitch outcome type. S=Strike, B=Ball, X=In play.
columns.hit_location: Fielder position number where ball was hit. 1=Pitcher, 2=Catcher, 3=1B, 4=2B, 5=3B, 6=SS, 7=LF, 8=CF, 9=RF.
columns.bb_type: Batted ball type: ground_ball, line_drive, fly_ball, or popup.
columns.balls: Number of balls in the count (0-3).
columns.strikes: Number of strikes in the count (0-2).
columns.pfx_x: Horizontal movement in FEET, from the catcher's perspective (gravity removed).
columns.pfx_z: Vertical movement in FEET, from the catcher's perspective (gravity removed).
columns.plate_x: Horizontal position of the ball in feet when it crosses home plate, from the catcher's perspective (0 = center). Through 2025 measured at the front of the plate; from 2026 at the middle of the plate (aligned with the ABS system).
columns.plate_z: Vertical position of the ball in feet above the ground when it crosses home plate. Through 2025 measured at the front of the plate; from 2026 at the middle of the plate (aligned with the ABS system).
columns.on_3b: MLBAM id of the runner on third base before the pitch (empty if none).
columns.on_2b: MLBAM id of the runner on second base before the pitch (empty if none).
columns.on_1b: MLBAM id of the runner on first base before the pitch (empty if none).
columns.outs_when_up: Number of outs when batter came to plate (0-2).
columns.inning: Inning number (1-9 for regulation, 10+ for extra innings).
columns.hc_x: Hit coordinate x of the batted ball (Savant spray-chart coordinates).
columns.hc_y: Hit coordinate y of the batted ball (Savant spray-chart coordinates).
columns.vx0: Velocity of the pitch in ft/s in the x direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.vy0: Velocity of the pitch in ft/s in the y direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.vz0: Velocity of the pitch in ft/s in the z direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.ax: Acceleration of the pitch in ft/s^2 in the x direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.ay: Acceleration of the pitch in ft/s^2 in the y direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.az: Acceleration of the pitch in ft/s^2 in the z direction, determined at y = 50 feet.
columns.sz_top: Top of the batter's strike zone in feet. Through 2025 set by the operator when the ball is halfway to the plate; from 2026 the top of the batter's ABS-defined strike zone.
columns.sz_bot: Bottom of the batter's strike zone in feet. Through 2025 set by the operator when the ball is halfway to the plate; from 2026 the bottom of the batter's ABS-defined strike zone.
columns.hit_distance_sc: Projected hit distance in feet based on launch speed and angle using physics model.
columns.launch_speed: Exit velocity of batted ball in miles per hour (mph). Higher values correlate with harder hits and better outcomes.
columns.launch_angle: Vertical angle of batted ball in degrees. Optimal for home runs is 25-35°. Line drives: 10-25°, fly balls: 25-50°, ground balls: <10°.
columns.effective_speed: Perceived velocity in mph, derived from release speed and the extension of the pitcher's release.
columns.release_spin_rate: Spin rate at release in revolutions per minute (rpm). Higher spin typically creates more movement.
columns.release_extension: Distance in feet from rubber to release point. Longer extension means ball is released closer to home plate.
columns.game_pk: Unique MLB Advanced Media game identifier.
columns.release_pos_y: Release position of the ball in feet from home plate (y, toward the mound).
columns.estimated_ba_using_speedangle: Expected batting average based on launch speed and angle from historical outcomes. Scale: 0-1.0 (e.g. 0.500 = 50% hit probability).
columns.estimated_woba_using_speedangle: Expected wOBA (xwOBA) of the batted ball from its exit velocity and launch angle (and, for some batted balls, sprint speed).
columns.woba_value: Actual wOBA value for the outcome weighted by run expectancy.
columns.woba_denom: wOBA denominator of the play (1 when the plate appearance counts toward wOBA, else 0).
columns.iso_value: ISO value of the play (extra bases: 1 for a double, 2 for a triple, 3 for a home run, else 0).
columns.launch_speed_angle: Launch speed/angle category: 1 = Weak, 2 = Topped, 3 = Under, 4 = Flare/Burner, 5 = Solid Contact, 6 = Barrel.
columns.at_bat_number: Sequential at-bat number within the game.
columns.pitch_number: Sequential pitch number within the at-bat.
columns.home_score: Home team score at time of pitch.
columns.away_score: Away team score at time of pitch.
columns.bat_score: Batting team score at time of pitch.
columns.fld_score: Fielding team score at time of pitch.
columns.post_away_score: Away team score after the play.
columns.post_home_score: Home team score after the play.
columns.post_bat_score: Batting team score after the play.
columns.post_fld_score: Fielding team score after the play.
columns.if_fielding_alignment: Infield positioning: Standard, Infield shift, or Strategic. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.of_fielding_alignment: Outfield positioning: Standard, 4th outfielder, or Strategic. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.spin_axis: Tilt of spin axis in degrees (0-360). 180° = pure backspin (fastball), 0° = pure topspin (12-6 curveball).
columns.delta_home_win_exp: Change in home team win expectancy after the play. Positive = increased win probability, negative = decreased.
columns.delta_run_exp: Change in run expectancy after the play measured in expected runs scored in remainder of inning.
columns.bat_speed: Bat speed in mph, measured at the sweet spot (six inches from the head of the bat). Filled on swings tracked by Statcast bat tracking (about 46% of all pitches). Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.swing_length: Swing length in feet: the total distance traveled by the head of the bat from the start of tracking until contact. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.miss_distance: Filled only on swinging strikes with bat tracking. Not yet in Savant's CSV documentation; Savant publishes it with its 'Swing Timing + Miss Distance' leaderboard. Values run from 0.1 to about 40 (median about 1.6), consistent with how far the bat missed the ball in inches; the unit is not documented. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.estimated_slg_using_speedangle: Expected slugging percentage based on launch speed and angle. Scale: 0-4.0 (1.0=single, 2.0=double, 3.0=triple, 4.0=HR).
columns.delta_pitcher_run_exp: Change in run expectancy from the pitcher's side (the negative of delta_run_exp).
columns.hyper_speed: Adjusted exit velocity in mph (Savant's 'Adjusted EV'): batted balls under 88 mph are set to 88, others keep their exit velocity.
columns.home_score_diff: Home team run differential (home score minus away score).
columns.home_win_exp: Home team win expectancy (0-1) at time of pitch based on score, inning, outs, and runners.
columns.age_pit_legacy: Pitcher's age on June 30 of the season (integer).
columns.age_bat_legacy: Batter's age on June 30 of the season (integer).
columns.age_pit: Pitcher's age on December 31 of the season (integer).
columns.age_bat: Batter's age on December 31 of the season (integer).
columns.n_thruorder_pitcher: Times through the batting order for the pitcher (1, 2, 3, ...).
columns.n_priorpa_thisgame_player_at_bat: Number of prior plate appearances by this batter in this game.
columns.pitcher_days_since_prev_game: Days since the pitcher's previous game (empty for his first game of the season).
columns.batter_days_since_prev_game: Days since the batter's previous game (empty for his first game of the season).
columns.pitcher_days_until_next_game: Days until the pitcher's next game (empty for his last game of the season).
columns.batter_days_until_next_game: Days until the batter's next game (empty for his last game of the season).
columns.api_break_z_with_gravity: Vertical break of the pitch in inches, gravity included.
columns.api_break_x_arm: Horizontal break of the pitch in inches toward the pitcher's arm side.
columns.api_break_x_batter_in: Horizontal break of the pitch in inches toward the batter's side of the plate.
columns.arm_angle: Pitcher's arm angle in degrees: the angle between a line parallel to the ground and a line from the throwing shoulder to the ball at release. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.attack_angle: Attack angle in degrees: the vertical angle, compared to the ground, of the direction the bat's sweet spot is traveling as it meets the ball. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.attack_direction: Attack direction in degrees: the horizontal angle of the direction the bat's sweet spot is traveling as it meets the ball, compared to the line from home plate to straightaway center field. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.swing_path_tilt: Swing path tilt in degrees: the vertical orientation of the plane of the swing, compared to the ground, over the 40 ms before contact. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_x_inches: Distance in inches between the bat/ball intercept point and the batter's center of mass, in the x (horizontal) direction. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.intercept_ball_minus_batter_pos_y_inches: Distance in inches between the bat/ball intercept point and the batter's center of mass, in the y (mound-to-plate) direction. Empty for the whole game at the neutral-site games listed in this file's description.
columns.pitch_uid: Added here: unique pitch id 'game_pk-at_bat_number-pitch_number' (checked unique across all three seasons).
columns.is_swing: Added here: the batter swung. True for descriptions swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, missed_bunt, foul_tip, bunt_foul_tip, swinging_pitchout, foul, foul_bunt, foul_pitchout and hit_into_play (daily totals equal Savant's swing counts).
columns.is_whiff: Added here: a whiff as Baseball Savant counts it: swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, missed_bunt, foul_tip, bunt_foul_tip and swinging_pitchout. Foul tips count as whiffs, as in Savant's own whiff totals (daily totals checked equal).
columns.in_zone: Added here: zone is 1-9 (True) or 11-14 (False); empty when zone is empty.

batter_season.csv.description: One row per batter and season: plate discipline, bat tracking averages and contact quality, aggregated from the pitch-level files.

columns.batter: MLBAM id of the batter (join to the pitch data's batter and players.player_id).
columns.pa: Plate appearances: pitches with a non-empty events value other than truncated_pa (a plate appearance cut short when the half-inning or game ended during it).
columns.avg_bat_speed: Mean bat_speed over every tracked swing (mph).
columns.competitive_swings: Savant's 'competitive' swings: the fastest 90% of the batter's tracked swings in the season, plus any 60+ mph swing with a 90+ mph exit velocity.
columns.avg_bat_speed_competitive: Mean bat_speed over competitive_swings, Savant's definition of seasonal average bat speed (mph). Small differences from Savant's leaderboard are possible.
columns.pitches: Rows in the pitch-level data for this player and season, including pitch-clock automatic balls/strikes (no pitch thrown; see automatic_calls).
columns.automatic_calls: Pitch-clock automatic balls and strikes (description automatic_ball / automatic_strike): counted in pitches, but no pitch was thrown.
columns.batted_balls_with_ev: Balls in play with a launch_speed (the denominator of hard_hit_rate).
columns.avg_exit_velocity: Mean launch_speed of balls in play, mph.
columns.hard_hit: Balls in play with launch_speed >= 95 mph.
columns.xwoba_on_contact: Mean estimated_woba_using_speedangle over balls in play.
columns.whiff_rate: whiffs / swings. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.zone_swing_rate: Swings at in-zone pitches / zone_pitches. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.chase_rate: Swings at out-of-zone pitches / chase_pitches. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.zone_rate: zone_pitches / (zone_pitches + chase_pitches). Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.hard_hit_rate: hard_hit / batted_balls_with_ev. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.woba: Sum of woba_value / sum of woba_denom. Empty when the denominator is 0.

pitcher_season.csv.description: One row per pitcher and season: whiffs, CSW, zone and chase rates, four-seam velocity and contact allowed, aggregated from the pitch-level files.

columns.pitcher: MLBAM id of the pitcher (join to the pitch data's pitcher and players.player_id).
columns.batters_faced: Plate appearances: pitches with a non-empty events value other than truncated_pa (a plate appearance cut short when the half-inning or game ended during it).
columns.four_seam_pitches: Four-seam fastballs (pitch_type FF) with a release_speed.
columns.tracked_swings_against: Swings against the pitcher with a bat_speed value.
columns.avg_bat_speed_against: Mean bat_speed of the swings against the pitcher (mph).
columns.pitches: Rows in the pitch-level data for this player and season, including pitch-clock automatic balls/strikes (no pitch thrown; see automatic_calls).
columns.automatic_calls: Pitch-clock automatic balls and strikes (description automatic_ball / automatic_strike): counted in pitches, but no pitch was thrown.
columns.batted_balls_with_ev: Balls in play with a launch_speed (the denominator of hard_hit_rate).
columns.avg_exit_velocity: Mean launch_speed of balls in play allowed, mph.
columns.hard_hit: Balls in play with launch_speed >= 95 mph.
columns.xwoba_on_contact: Mean estimated_woba_using_speedangle over balls in play.
columns.whiff_rate: whiffs / swings. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.zone_swing_rate: Swings at in-zone pitches / zone_pitches. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.chase_rate: Swings at out-of-zone pitches / chase_pitches. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.zone_rate: zone_pitches / (zone_pitches + chase_pitches). Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.hard_hit_rate: hard_hit / batted_balls_with_ev. Empty when the denominator is 0.
columns.woba: Sum of woba_value / sum of woba_denom. Empty when the denominator is 0.

players.csv.description: Every batter and pitcher id in the pitch data with name, bats and throws from MLB StatsAPI.

columns.player_id: MLBAM player id (batter / pitcher in the pitch data).
columns.bats: Bat side: R, L or S (switch).
columns.primary_position: Primary position abbreviation (StatsAPI, as of the build date).

tracking_gaps.csv.description: Games played more than 30 days before the build whose Statcast tracking columns are empty or thinly filled for the whole game (for example no bat tracking anywhere in the 2024 opening week, or a park's spin tracking down for a game). These gaps are permanent in Baseball Savant; the rows are in the season files with those columns empty. Neutral-site games without Hawk-Eye are not listed here.

columns.game_pk: MLB game id; joins to game_pk in the season files.
columns.empty_columns: Columns empty on every pitch of the game, separated by ';'.
columns.partial_columns: Columns filled on fewer pitches than the usual floor, as 'column share<floor', separated by ';'.
columns.xwoba_share: Share of batted balls with expected wOBA.
